caption: The drawing depicts a tall, upright grandfather clock with a rectangular base and a broader upper section that houses the clock face. The entire clock is rendered in a brown woodgrain pattern with subtle yellow highlights around its edges, suggesting wood trim or inlay. The lower portion consists of a solid panel on a base with short feet. The middle section is a tall, narrow door or panel, framed by vertical trim and topped with an arched decorative detail matching the style of the base. The upper portion, or hood, is topped with a cornice and features an arched top above the clock face. The clock face itself is white, circular, and set within a square border. The face has black Roman numerals marking the hours, with two black clock hands pointing to the time. Above the numeral twelve, text can be seen, and there are additional decorative details around the clock’s mechanism. The background is off-white or cream, with no other objects present in the image.
title: Grandfather Clock
